annotation.title_clean: Inter-American Framework on Data Governance and Artificial Intelligence (MIGDIA)
annotation.title_en: Inter-American Framework on Data Governance and Artificial Intelligence (MIGDIA)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Organization of American States (OAS), Department for Effective Public Management
annotation.summary_en: OAS programme page describing MIGDIA, a regional initiative guiding member states on data and AI governance in public administration. It lists 12-area guidelines, a regional study, and a model policy, co-created via working groups, with technical assistance to Brazil and Argentina. No embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: MIGDIA offers guidelines in 12 thematic areas as a roadmap for member states
Includes a study on data and AI governance in the Americas and a model policy
Developed through co-creation with government, civil society and private-sector working groups
Technical assistance provided to Brazil and Argentina for data governance frameworks
Publications from November 2024 include the Inter-American Guidelines and a draft Model Policy
